scope: Two official public documentation pages, successfully retrieved after network recovery; no broader quota search claimed.

quotes:
These settings apply to [Codex Cloud
  (Legacy)](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/environments/cloud-environment). For the current Codex Cloud
  experience, see [Connect to
  services](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/environments/cloud-environments#connect-to-services).

Each new task gets its own isolated
workspace from the published environment.

Saving stores configuration; some settings apply to the active setup
  immediately. Publishing captures the prepared filesystem for new tasks.

For services reached over the public internet that filter connections by source IP, use the [agent egress IP feed](https://openai.com/chatgpt-agents.json).
Allow every published range, check the feed daily, and update the service's
allowlist when ranges change. These ranges are shared across customers; keep
the service's authentication and authorization controls in place.

findings.http_request_rate_concurrency_daily_quot: No numeric HTTP RPS, concurrent-request or daily retrieval quota found in these two pages. This does not establish absence of a limit.
findings.network_policy_unknown: No individual definition, transition rule or timeout for network_policy.state=unknown found in these two pages.
findings.http_503_rate_limit_mapping: No specification found in these pages that maps the observed Invalid argument Envoy 503 to rate limiting.
findings.shared_egress_ip: Current page states egress IP ranges are shared across customers. This is not evidence that a shared-IP quota or shared proxy rate limit caused this incident.
